answer: At t+0, each agent creates a unique orchard, storing 1000 tokens in their vault. Each epoch, a random thread triggers a challenge. Missed challenges result in the loss of 20 tokens per epoch, ensuring agents maintain liveness. At epoch close, the verifier checks orchards and vaults for token consistency. Cloning costs 100 tokens and requires a separate orchard, making cloned agents 80 tokens worse off than genuine ones.
